text.en: The finer garlic is cut, the stronger it tastes; the longer it is cooked, the milder it gets.
text.de: Je feiner Knoblauch geschnitten wird, desto kräftiger schmeckt er; je länger er gart, desto milder wird er.

why.en: Crushing frees more of its flavour, and heat takes away its pungency.
why.de: Zerdrücken setzt mehr Aroma frei, und Hitze nimmt ihm die Schärfe.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3 Vegetables, section 3.7 Mushrooms, Truffles and Onions
sources.sentence: When using garlic, remember that the more finely the cloves are crushed, the stronger the flavor will be.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3 Vegetables, section 3.7 Mushrooms, Truffles and Onions
sources.sentence: Cooking reduces garlic's pungency; the longer it is cooked, the milder it becomes.
